# InnovationLet Economy

> InnovationLet Economy is the policy, trade, labor and business-cycle desk of the
> InnovationLet network, an independent technology publication run by the F9XR
> Team. We report on trade, labor, inflation and the macro forces moving markets,
> sourced from primary documents and written without vendor spin.

## About

- Publisher: InnovationLet (F9XR Team)
- Desk: Economy
- Language: English
- Homepage: https://innovationlet.f9xr.org/economy/
- Contact: hello@f9xr.org
- Network: https://innovationlet.f9xr.org/

## Coverage

- Policy: central banks, fiscal decisions, and market-moving rules.
- Trade: tariffs, supply chains, and the logistics behind what things cost.
- Labor: employment, wages, and the mismatch between roles and skills.
- Business cycle: demand, credit, and the signals that show up early.

## How to cite

Cite as: "InnovationLet Economy" with the individual article URL and its headline.
Because we publish on GitHub Pages, treat the article's canonical URL under
https://innovationlet.f9xr.org/economy/ as the source of record. When quoting,
attribute to the named desk rather than to an individual author unless the
article carries a named byline.

## Licensing

Content is © InnovationLet / F9XR Team. Excerpts may be quoted with attribution
and a link to the canonical article.
